outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge channels); it contains no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel B includes micrographs plus two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20) but no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a Western blot image with no averaged plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D includes micrographs plus two bar charts (SDH and COX signal intensity) showing means with error bars and sample sizes indicated in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell number vs. TMRM intensity), which are line/density plots; overlaying individual points on such distributions is not applicable and would make them unreadable.
